prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning (beds/booths) or a spray/airbrush tan? And what part of Charlotte or what ZIP code are you in? If you tell me that I can look up current top-rated salons near you and recommend the best options.

Until then, quick guidance to help you pick the best salon:
- Choose by type: spray/airbrush is far safer than UV beds (skin-cancer risk). If you want an even, natural result, look for an experienced airbrush tech who will do a patch test and show before/after photos.
- Check reviews: prefer salons with many recent 4–5 star reviews on Google and Yelp, and lots of recent photos of results.
- Ask about products: reputable spray salons use Mystic/Versa/MineTan solutions or premium organic blends. For UV, ask about bed types, bulb age, and adjustable levels.
- Cleanliness & safety: booths should be clean, well-ventilated; technicians should offer disposable nose filters/eye protection for spray; ask about COVID/illness policies if relevant.
- Technician credentials: certified airbrush artists or technicians who provide portfolio photos and client references are better.
- Price & packages: compare single-session price vs membership or package deals; many salons offer a first-time special.
- Do a patch/strand test for color match and longevity before full-body application.

If you tell me spray vs. UV and your neighborhood/ZIP, I’ll pull current top picks with addresses, phone numbers, and what makes each one stand out.
